description: Specialized gates for Terraform and OpenTofu infrastructure workflows. Loaded when tool context matches Terraform plan, validate, apply, destroy, state, or plan JSON review commands.

gates.message: Terraform destroy is blocked. Require an approved plan JSON review, explicit environment scope, rollback path, and human approval before destructive infrastructure removal.
Terraform apply without a saved plan artifact is risky. Generate a plan, export it with terraform show -json, review the JSON, then apply the approved plan artifact.
Terraform plan JSON evidence detected. Attach the risk summary before apply: replacements, deletes, IAM changes, public ingress, database changes, and cost-sensitive resources.
Terraform state mutation detected. Human approval required because state edits can hide drift or detach managed infrastructure from review.
Public ingress detected in Terraform. Require explicit business justification, port scope, security group name, and expiry or compensating control.
Wildcard IAM detected in Terraform. Require least-privilege scope or an explicit, time-boxed exception before merge or apply.
Database infrastructure replacement risk detected. Require backup proof, maintenance window, rollback plan, and owner approval.
